label: For every being x and principle r, if the esse of x is received in r, then r is the essence of x
paraphrase: Open, unattributed premise: for every being x and principle r, if the esse of x is received in r, then r is the essence of x. De ente c.4 and ST I q.7 a.2 say this only for created intellectual substances and subsistent created forms; the generalization is not attributed to them. It does not assert that any esse is received and says nothing about forms received in matter.
